sequenceReference.note: This package closes step 4 (one-golden-slice) of the pinned runtime-start sequence for CreateCustomer@1 by composing five already-GREEN upstream evidence records into one package-local closure claim. It writes no new production code and edits none of the composed evidence. It does not open a hosted HTTP server, host/runtime selection, or any release/deploy/production step of that sequence.

goal: Add the smallest closure record proving the one-golden-slice step is closed for CreateCustomer@1 by composing existing generated-sdk, adapter commit-receipt, framework-neutral composition, and ASGI boundary conformance evidence, without editing any of the composed evidence and without adding a server/host/framework.
nonGoals: no HTTP server, no ASGI host/runtime, no Uvicorn/Hypercorn/FastAPI/Django selection or import

generatedSdkStepClosure.contributes: proves the generated-sdk step (step 3 of the pinned sequence) is closed for CreateCustomer@1 by composing the src/sdk boundary, the pinned protocol contract, the materialized artifact, and the deterministic generator

customerCommitReceipt.contributes: proves customer_records, audit, transactional outbox, and idempotency all commit atomically in one attested tenant transaction, returning a full frozen CommitReceipt with no deferred intents

frameworkNeutralComposition.contributes: proves a framework-neutral composition root wires CreateCustomerRequestHandler, CreateCustomerCommitService, and PostgresCommitAdapter together with no HTTP server, ASGI runtime, or framework selected

asgiCompositionBodyLimit.contributes: proves the ASGI composition callable enforces an optional, framework-neutral request body byte limit, short-circuiting an over-limit request before the commit path, with no host/server/framework selected

asgiReceiveMoreBodyConformance.contributes: proves the ASGI receive loop rejects a malformed present http.request.more_body value with the existing deterministic 400 profile response, closing an ASGI receive-event conformance gap, before the current package started

asgiCompositionDockerCommitTest.testName: createCustomerAsgiComposition.app carries an ALLOW+invariants-ok POST /customers request to a real PostgreSQL 16 commit
asgiCompositionDockerCommitTest.contributes: a Docker-backed real PostgreSQL 16 test asserting the current ASGI composition callable, as bounded and conformant by the two composed ASGI evidence records above, carries an ALLOW+invariants-ok POST /customers request through to a real commit

closureClaim.note: Composing the five records and the named Docker-backed test above shows the Kernel-side customer.create path is provably wired end to end: typed action/generated SDK contract -> framework-neutral composition root -> ASGI-bounded, receive-conformant callable -> atomic four-intent PostgreSQL commit with a full CommitReceipt. This is a package-local step closure only. It does not claim a hosted HTTP server exists, that any host/server/framework has been selected, or that the Kernel, an SDK, an app, a release, a deploy, or production is ready.

flagsNote: oneGoldenSliceStepClosed/generatedSdkStepClosed/gapClosed are package-local step-closure claims for this GJ-01 slice only: they say the composed evidence chain above already proves the pinned sequence's one-golden-slice step. oneGoldenSliceReady is deliberately kept false because a step being provably closed by composed evidence is not the same as a global readiness claim; there is still no hosted HTTP server, host/runtime selection, or app around this composed path.
capabilityDelta: NONE: this package writes no production code and adds no new runtime behavior. It only records, in one place, that the existing GREEN evidence chain already proves the one-golden-slice step for CreateCustomer@1.

userJourney.once: CreateCustomer@1 için kanıt çok sayıda ayrı parçaya (SDK üretim paketi, adaptör commit paketi, kompozisyon paketi, ASGI sınır paketleri, Docker'lı gerçek PostgreSQL testi) dağılmış durumdaydı; kimse tek bir kayda bakıp 'bu adım kapandı mı' diyemiyordu.
userJourney.simdi: Artık tek bir kapanış kaydı, bu beş kanıtı ve Docker'lı gerçek PostgreSQL commit testini isim ve dosya yoluyla birbirine bağlıyor: typed action/SDK sözleşmesinden ASGI çağrılabilirine, oradan gerçek PostgreSQL commit'ine kadar customer.create yolunun kanıtlanabilir olduğunu tek bir yerden okuyabilirsiniz.
userJourney.fark: Sadece yeni bir planning JSON kaydı ve onu doğrulayan bir test eklendi; hiçbir üretim kodu, veritabanı şeması veya araç değişmedi.
userJourney.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir tenant customer.create isteği gönderdiğinde, Kernel tarafındaki yol (SDK sözleşmesi -> kompozisyon -> ASGI callable -> PostgreSQL commit) artık uçtan uca kanıtlanmış durumda. Ama hâlâ bu callable'ı dinleyen gerçek bir HTTP sunucusu veya kullanıcı ekranı yok; bu paket sadece Kernel tarafının kanıt zincirini birleştiriyor.
userJourney.kalanEngel: Hosted bir HTTP sunucusu/host adaptörü hâlâ yok; bu yüzden runnableProduct ve appBuildable hâlâ false. Bu paket bir sunucu/framework seçimi yapmıyor ve production/release/deploy iddiası taşımıyor.
